## Biographical Information

(Scotland 1819-1879)

Anne Sturges Bourne's farm bailiff

He married (1852) Miss Sturges Bourne's former ladies' maid [Ellen Brown](person_1820.qmd) (b. Cranbrook, Kent 1825/6), who died in 1860 leaving several young children. [1861 census;  marriage and death register]
